#Print Multiplication Table
Problem Statement:
Given an integer N, print its multiplication table up to 10.
Input Description:
A single integer N.
Output Description:
Print 10 multiples of N separated by space.
Sample Input:
5
Sample Output:
5 10 15 20 25 30 35 40 45 50
